verified_root_cause.evidence: GitHub account notification reported 2,000 / 2,000 included Actions minutes used; jobs failed before runner allocation.
verified_root_cause.correction_to_original_hypothesis: The original external-control-plane/account-admission classification was directionally upstream of workflow steps but incomplete; account quota exhaustion was the verified immediate cause.

resolution.repository_visibility_change: User changed repositories to public, removing standard public hosted-runner use from the private included-minute constraint.
resolution.post_recovery_result: Runner allocated and full pytest executed, revealing real repository regression debt instead of pre-allocation failure.
resolution.resource_governance: UAOS CI now cancels superseded runs and skips redundant main-push full CI for observation/readiness/README-only changes while retaining PR/manual verification.
